{{Quote|Corporal Amden vor Keioidian. You did the Republic proud.|Jace Malcom, to Keioidian|<ref name="TLBoCJM" />}}
'''Amden vor Keioidian''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual who served as a [[Corporal/Legends|corporal]] in the [[Republic Army]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. Keioidian joined [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Shanra Immel's squad]] and was tasked with destroying a [[Kalandis Seven's spaceport|spaceport]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kalandis Seven]]. On the way to the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]], Keioidian was critically wounded and was left behind by his [[Squad/Legends|squad]] as they pushed on to continue the mission.

==Biography==
{{Quote|You did all of ''us'' proud. And we'll be back for you.|Jace Malcom, to Keioidian|<ref name="TLBoCJM" />}}
In [[3640 BBY]],<ref name="Time">{{TOR_dates|4}} The short story "[[The Last Battle of Colonel Jace Malcom]]" takes place shortly after the [[Battle of Corellia]], which occurs during the class storyline finales. According to {{TORcite|type=flashpoint|The Battle of Ilum}}, the Battle of Ilum was an extended campaign that began after the conclusion of the Battle of Corellia. Therefore, "The Last Battle of Colonel Jace Malcom" must take place between the two battles, therefore dating the story in 3640 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].</ref> Amden vor Keioidian was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual who held the rank of [[Corporal/Legends|corporal]] in the [[Republic Army]] and was assigned to [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Shanra Immel's squad]].<ref name="TLBoCJM" /> That same [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="Time" /> during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], Keioidian and his [[Squad/Legends|squad]] were paired with [[Republic Special Forces Division]] [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Jace Malcom]] during a [[Battle of Kalandis Seven|battle]] on [[Kalandis Seven]], a desolate [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]].<ref name="TLBoCJM" />

[[File:Malcom_and_Immel.png|thumb|right|250px|Colonel Malcom (left) and Sergeant Immel (right) disagreed on how to best assist a wounded Keioidian.]]
During the course of the battle, Keioidian and the squad were tasked with the destruction of a [[Kalandis Seven's spaceport|local Imperial-controlled spaceport]]. On the way to the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]], Keioidian was wounded when he and the squad were attacked by members of the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]]. [[Shanra Immel|Immel]] attempted to heal his wounds with an [[Autodoc/Legends|autodoc]], but the device labeled Keioidian's condition as critical. She and Colonel Malcom briefly had a disagreement about whether or not to activate Keioidian's [[med tracer]], a device that would allow Republic forces to circle back later and pick up any wounded soldiers. However, activating one ran the inherent risk of Imperial forces picking up on the transmission and [[Death/Legends|killing]] the wounded before there was any chance of rescue.<ref name="TLBoCJM" />

Ultimately, Immel elected to activate the tracer and ordered the squad to move out, leaving Keioidian behind. Before departing, Colonel Malcom told the corporal that he had made both the squad and the Republic proud and promised that the group would be back for him.<ref name="TLBoCJM" />

==Behind the scenes==
Amden vor Keioidian appeared in [[Alexander Freed]]'s short story "[[The Last Battle of Colonel Jace Malcom]]," which was published in the [[Star Wars Insider 137|137th issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' magazine<ref name="TLBoCJM" /> on [[October 23]], [[2012]].<ref name="Titan">{{TitanMagazines|url=t/star-wars-insider/us/137|text=Star Wars Insider Issue #137}}</ref>
